name: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
label: Quest
description: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, adventurer. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.

You'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.
Return once your journey is done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you yet traveled the continent? Enlightenment awaits you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, here you are. A little wearier, a bit dustier, but enlightened! The heat touches us all during this season and unites us; your very being glows with the power of the fires you touched.
Ah, but these days enlightenment is taken as a rather poor reward for being sent on a task, I suppose. Take these, then, and enjoy the celebration.
